title: Newmark Arranges Historic $508M Sale of The Summit, Alabama's Premier Lifestyle Destination
summary: Newmark Group, Inc. announces the Company has arranged the $508 million sale of The Summit, an 870,000-square-foot, mixed-use lifestyle destination in Birmingham, Alabama.
body_markdown: Newmark Group, Inc. announces the Company has arranged the $508 million sale of The Summit, an 870,000-square-foot, mixed-use lifestyle destination in Birmingham, Alabama.
